turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’m feeling nauseous, like I might vomit. I also have pain around my chest area, and the pain is about 7 out of 10.
Can you describe what the chest pain feels like
It’s a tedious, heavy, scary pain.
Does the pain spread anywhere else, like to your

Yes. It radiates to my thyroid cartilage, under the jaw, trachea, and my shoulders (right and left), and the pain is in my lower chest, biceps (right), and upper chest including both breasts (right and left).
When did this pain start, and what were you doing
I don’t know. The pain’s pace at which it appears is 10.
Are you experiencing any shortness of breath, sweating, or dizziness along with the chest pain?
Do you have any medical conditions like high blood pressure, diabetes, or a history of heart problems?
Yes—I have diabetes, high blood pressure (and I take medications to treat it), and I’ve had a heart attack or angina (chest pain).
